description.value: Parkinson Recreation Centre is a full-service civic recreation facility operated by the City of Kelowna offering an indoor pool, hot tub, steam sauna, fitness centre, and basketball. As a municipally run centre it serves both residents and visitors looking to recover, train, or swim during a tour through the Okanagan. Admission fees apply.
